command:
set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; state(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1; }; voice_block(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys audio | sed -n '/- STREAM_VOICE_CALL:/,/Volume Group: AUDIO_STREAM_VOICE_CALL/p'; }; cleanup(){ python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }; trap cleanup EXIT; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state | grep -qx device; test "$(state)" = "0"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 || true; PRE=$(voice_block); printf '%s
' "$PRE"; printf '%s
' "$PRE" | grep -q 'Muted: true'; printf '%s
' "$PRE" | grep -q 'streamVolume:0'; echo silent_voice_guard_pre_call=true; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" dial 510100100; ACTIVE=0; for i in $(seq 1 50); do ST=$(state); echo live_call_state=$ST; [ "$ST" = "2" ] && ACTIVE=1 && break; sleep 0.4; done; test "$ACTIVE" = "1"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 || true; VOICE=$(voice_block); printf '%s
' "$VOICE"; printf '%s
' "$VOICE" | grep -q 'Muted: true'; printf '%s
' "$VOICE" | grep -q 'streamVolume:0'; printf '%s
' "$VOICE" | grep -q 'Devices: earpiece(1)'; echo silent_audio_guard_active=true; APK=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge | cut -d: -f2 | head -n1); test -n "$APK"; OUT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.BidirectionalMediaProbe live-smoke 3000"); printf '%s
' "$OUT"; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'probe=bidirectional-media-v3'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'mode=live-smoke'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'downlink_context_package=android'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'uplink_context_package=com.android.shell'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'active_after_start=true'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'heartbeat_after_start=true'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'uplink_dtmf_digit=1'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'uplink_bytes_written=9600'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'bytes_read=96000'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'samples_read=48000'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'half_sample_carry=false'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'active_before_abort=true'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'heartbeat_before_abort=true'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'prepared_after_abort=false'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'active_after_abort=false'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'heartbeat_after_abort=false'; NZ=$(printf '%s
' "$OUT" | sed -n 's/^non_zero_samples=//p' | tail -n1); PK=$(printf '%s
' "$OUT" | sed -n 's/^peak=//p' | tail -n1); RMS=$(printf '%s
' "$OUT" | sed -n 's/^rms=//p' | tail -n1); echo live_nonzero_samples=$NZ live_peak=$PK live_rms=$RMS; test -n "$NZ"; test "$NZ" -gt 0; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup; sleep 1; test "$(state)" = "0"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0 >/dev/null; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; trap - EXIT; echo phase2_bidirectional_live_silent_ok=true
